summary: The filing reports a routine monthly sale of unregistered equity securities under Regulation D and a regular distribution declaration. New Mountain Private Credit Fund sold 55,627 common shares at $23.37 per share for aggregate proceeds of ~$1.3 million, exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506. The board declared a $0.19/share distribution payable May 29, 2026. NAV as of March 31, 2026 was $23.37 per share. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other special situation is involved; it is an ordinary capital raise and dividend announcement. No deal terms apply.
